definitions.gloss: meeting; greeting someone on arrival; reception
definitions.explanation: The act of going to meet someone who is arriving, such as at an airport, station, or entrance. Derived from the verb 出迎える (to go out to meet).

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}まで{出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'll go to the airport to meet them.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}で{友人|ゆうじん}の{出迎|でむか}えをした。
examples.english: I met my friend at the station.

examples.japanese: {大統領|だいとうりょう}の{出迎|でむか}えのため、{大勢|おおぜい}の{人|ひと}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: A large crowd gathered to greet the president on arrival.

notes:
Noun form of the verb {出迎|でむか}える (to go out and meet someone arriving).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {出迎|でむか}えに{行|い}く: to go to meet someone
- {出迎|でむか}えに{来|く}る: to come to meet someone
- {出迎|でむか}えをする: to greet an arrival
- {出迎|でむか}えの{人|ひと}: person meeting an arrival

USAGE:
Typically used when meeting someone at a station, airport, or entrance. Implies going to a specific place to receive someone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出迎|でむか}え: greeting someone on arrival
- {見送|みおく}り: seeing someone off (opposite action)

REGISTER:
In business or formal settings, お{出迎|でむか}え adds the polite prefix お.
